sources.C.shot_noise_riu_1s: Dowran et al., Optica 5, 628 (2018): coherent-state sensitivity 8.6e-10 RIU/sqrt(Hz), twin beams 5.5e-10, measured at a 199 kHz modulation
sources.C.technical_noise_riu_1s: Biacore T200 spec: baseline noise <0.03 RU RMS (1 RU = 1e-6 RIU), so 3e-8 RIU is a best case; drift adds ~0.3 RU/min. Cross-instrument comparison with Dowran
sources.C.eta: Dowran et al. 2018: ~9 dB generated, ~4 dB after the sensor, so eta = (1-0.40)/(1-0.126) = 0.69; generated_db 9
sources.C.need: An SPR biosensor for the detection of microcystins in drinking water (EPA HERO 7429052): competitive assay, LOD 73 +/- 8 ng/L, 4 samples per 60 min; WHO guideline 1 ug/L
sources.D.shot_noise_riu_1s: normalised: shot-noise-limited at the photodamage limit (Casacio et al., Nature 594, 201, 2021)
sources.D.eta_generated_db: Casacio et al. 2021 SI: total efficiency 0.44 (microscope 0.75 x optics 0.82 x detector 0.72); 35 % power-SNR gain = 1.3 dB detected = 1.16x in RMSE; generated_db 4.2 reproduces it
